rationale: Y independently surfaces the import-aliasing pattern that underlies three of the eight ground-truth comments (and touches the test-relocation theme in comment 1), while X matches essentially none of the ground truth and repeatedly asserts as 'validated' that entrypoints/serving files and run_curl_*.sh were untouched — directly contradicted by ground-truth comments anchored on exactly those files. Both candidates independently catch the same real openai_chat_client.py partial-size bug and the registry media-validation regression, but Y backs its top findings with actual runtime reproduction (LingBot mode resolution, stage-modality warning) giving it an edge in grounding, while X pads with a near-duplicate finding at the same registry.py:316 location. X's CI-marker-mismatch root-cause finding is a genuine unique value-add, but it doesn't offset the recall gap and the false 'unchanged files' claims that undercut precision.
